question: Which top-level packaging containers, meaning those not contained within any other packaging, have any item for which the total quantity accumulated across all nested levels in the hierarchy exceeds 500, and what are the names of both these containers and the corresponding items?
sql:
WITH RECURSIVE packaging_tree AS (
    SELECT 
        p.id AS top_id,
        p.name AS top_name,
        p.id AS current_id,
        pr.contains_id AS child_id,
        pr.qty AS accumulated_qty,
        1 AS depth
    FROM packaging p
    JOIN packaging_relations pr ON pr.packaging_id = p.id
    WHERE p.id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT contains_id FROM packaging_relations)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        pt.top_id,
        pt.top_name,
        pt.child_id,
        pr.contains_id,
        pt.accumulated_qty * pr.qty,
        pt.depth + 1
    FROM packaging_tree pt
    JOIN packaging_relations pr ON pr.packaging_id = pt.child_id
),
leaf_items AS (
    SELECT p.id, p.name
    FROM packaging p
    WHERE p.id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT packaging_id FROM packaging_relations)
)
SELECT 
    pt.top_id,
    pt.top_name,
    li.id AS item_id,
    li.name AS item_name,
    SUM(pt.accumulated_qty) AS total_quantity
FROM packaging_tree pt
JOIN leaf_items li ON li.id = pt.child_id
GROUP BY pt.top_id, pt.top_name, li.id, li.name
HAVING SUM(pt.accumulated_qty) > 500
ORDER BY pt.top_id, li.id
